scope: Follow-up preview ensuring each of the declared 25 teaching cards owns a Blue label and a Navy title across nine sources, four PC sizes and both modes.

historical_issue.before: Concept and overfitting had Navy titles but no Blue labels owned by their cards. The previous selected-role color audit could pass using the page kicker and did not prove per-card label presence.
historical_issue.previous_review_limitation: The earlier review accepted the selected-role scope and certified existing colors, not each card label/title pair. Earlier reviewer.json and static-review.json remain historical records, not evidence of this follow-up version.
historical_issue.after: Concept has IMAGE REPRESENTATION above its existing Navy heading. Overfitting has two Blue definition labels and two Blue figure labels paired with Navy headings. CARD_PAIRS requires exactly one visible Blue label and one visible Navy title inside each selected card; page-level h1/kicker cannot substitute.

visual_checks.concept: Blue label and existing Navy title form a clear pair. The image-to-channel-to-pixel flow, captions, RGB values, takeaway and footer remain contained and readable after the extra label row.
visual_checks.overfitting_definitions: Each English Blue label sits above its Korean Navy title. Both unchanged 19px/22px definitions remain one line, match vertically and fit the card padding.
visual_checks.overfitting_figure_headers: LOSS CURVE and IMAGE PREDICTION are visible Blue labels with Navy titles. The left label/title row remains separate from the complete training/validation legend, with no overlap or wrapping.
visual_checks.loss_definition: The Loss meaning occupies the first text row within the graph and remains separated from the selection arrow and plot.
visual_checks.figures: Unchanged curves, minimum marker, guide, rightward conditional region, axes, fruit illustrations, same-model transfer and prediction mapping remain readable.
visual_checks.contact: The nine-source contact shows the new pairs and consistent role-color hierarchy; the eight-view overfitting contact shows all requested PC/mode views without clipping.

preservation.guard: Only the six explicit original paths may differ, each checked against exact manifest before/after SHA256. Other original sources remain strict.

regression.coverage: Original-reference rendering/fonts/six viewports, interactive boundary states, dual-mode regression, logistic regression, gradient descent, documentation checks, heading roles/card presence, and dedicated overfitting checks all have successful current CI evidence.

limits: This is an internal preview review pass for user review; common Markdown remains unfinalized and user approval is not inferred.
The 25 teaching cards are the declared card-pair scope. Small metric tiles, semantic axis/data/condition/result labels and individual fruit images are not all required to receive new category labels.
The new requirement is card-owned label/title presence. Their relative positions follow each existing pattern; the audit does not claim every Blue label sits above its title.

Direct final visual inspection covers the changed Concept/overfitting full-size images, the nine-source contact and all eight overfitting views. Other sources retain the prior reviewed product styling and have current full regression evidence.
The historical color-only review is preserved. This separate JSON records the stronger card-presence audit and its result.
No universal independent-author reproduction claim, new-concept reuse pass for all eight patterns, common-rule finalization, or main merge approval is made.
